## Security and integrity review

- [ ] No bundled executables, install scripts, credentials, private data or suspicious links.
- [ ] No modification to official artifact hashes unless publishing a NEW, independently verified release.
- [ ] No attempts to create a privileged workflow, automatic release, or self-hosted runner.
- [ ] Reviewer inspected the complete changed-file list and author-added commits.
- [ ] Screenshots use anonymized data and correctly identify the build they show.

**Release binaries are not accepted as untrusted PR uploads.** Releases are published only by a maintainer after a separate, verified packaging process.

[Security policy](../SECURITY.md).
